data.text/markdown:
Separation notes

  • All SQL and metric logic is inside AttendanceAnalyser.
  • Marimo cells only instantiate the class, bind UI controls, and call methods.
  • The class can be moved to its own module (attendance.py) and imported if you want even cleaner separation.
